verdict.rationale: Morph's docs publish concrete speed figures for several components: Fast Apply at 10,500 tok/s with 98% accuracy, Compact at 33,000 tok/s, Reflex classifiers at ~90ms per turn, and morph-v3-fast at 10,500+ tok/s. These are bare vendor claims, though, and the GitHub demos cite an older 4,500+ tok/s figure that is not reconciled with them. Missing for 10: benchmark methodology or reproducible benchmark results, latency percentiles or time-to-first-token figures, load-testing guides, speed numbers for the open-weight chat models such as Kimi K3, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the throughput claims.
